issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces persecution for criticizing authorities or for being Rastafarian
issues.applicant_position: Persecuted for criticizing Saint Vincent authorities and for Rastafarian faith; mental health worsened.
issues.result_text: Panel cannot conclude serious possibility of persecution for critical comments or Rastafarian religion.

issues.issue: Whether mental health problems, alone or with religion, justify refugee protection
issues.applicant_position: Mental illness worsened by persecution for opinions and faith; cannot safely return.
issues.result_text: Mental health problems alone or combined with religion do not justify refugee protection.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces risk to life, torture or cruel treatment on return (section 97)
issues.applicant_position: Sister says he would be beaten again if returned to Saint Vincent.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not prove risk of torture, death or cruel treatment if returned.
